name: czgameframe_destructor
description: CZGameFrame::Destructor restores the frame vtable, releases the owned bitmap object through the GDI provider path, resets the bitmap base vtable, and tears down the CFrameWnd base.
known_limits: VC COFF coverage is registered through czgameframe_window_methods; the 0x443830 byte check still fails because the generated VC5 MFC-derived destructor omits the retail call at 0x443850 before CBitmap member cleanup.

The native smoke initializes the CZGameFrame bitmap member in frame storage, attaches an owned bitmap, calls CZGameFrame::Destructor, and verifies that DeleteObject/reset teardown clears the bitmap handle without a provider exception.
